test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a PSU?
solution:
The correct answer is __**BSNL**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **BSNL** stands for Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited.
 
• It is a government-owned telecommunications service provider in India.
 
• BSNL was incorporated on 15th September 2000.
 
• It is headquartered in New Delhi, India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **SAIL** (Steel Authority of India Limited)

 
 
• SAIL is one of the largest state-owned steel-making companies based in New Delhi, India.
 
• It is a Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) owned by the Government of India.
 
• SAIL was founded in 1954 and operates several steel plants across India.
 
 
 
• **ONGC** (Oil and Natural Gas Corporation)
 
 
• ONGC is a multinational oil and gas company headquartered in New Delhi, India.
 
• It is a Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) under the administrative control of the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas.
 
• ONGC was founded on 14th August 1956.
 
 
 
• **GAIL** (Gas Authority of India Limited)
 
 
• GAIL is the largest state-owned natural gas processing and distribution company in India.
 
• It is a Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) under the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas.
 
• GAIL was established in August 1984.
